description: This PHP source file defines the Vtiger_MailScannerInfo class, which manages mail scanner configuration, including initialization, updating, deleting, and retrieving scanner details, folder info, and associated rules within the vtiger CRM system.

classes.name: Vtiger_MailScannerInfo
classes.description: Manages mail scanner configurations, including initialization, updates, folder info, rules, and database interactions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the mail scanner info object, optionally loading data based on scanner name.

methods.name: __crypt
methods.description: Encrypts or decrypts the input password using the Encryption class.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Loads scanner data from the database based on scanner name.

methods.name: initializeFolderInfo
methods.description: Initializes folder scan and rescan info from the database.

methods.name: clearLastscan
methods.description: Deletes last scan data for the scanner from the database.

methods.name: updateAllFolderRescan
methods.description: Updates the rescan flag for all folders.

methods.name: updateLastscan
methods.description: Updates last scan date and rescan flag for a specific folder.

methods.name: getLastscan
methods.description: Retrieves the last scan date for a folder.

methods.name: needRescan
methods.description: Checks if a folder needs rescanning.

methods.name: checkRescan
methods.description: Checks if any folder requires rescanning.

methods.name: getFolderInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about all folders associated with the scanner.

methods.name: updateFolderInfo
methods.description: Updates folder info in the database, adding or removing folders as needed.

methods.name: enableFoldersForScan
methods.description: Enables only specified folders for scanning.

methods.name: initializeRules
methods.description: Loads associated mail scanner rules from the database.

methods.name: getAsMap
methods.description: Returns scanner info as an associative array.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compares this scanner instance with another for key attribute equality.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates or inserts scanner info into the database, handling server changes.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the scanner and related data from the database.
